title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 1.27 (versions follow prime numbers; 127 after 113). On a shelf of five domains (the New Testament, Don Quijote, a diary, source code and three questions) and with the same instincts, a recipe made by Luma read 1008812 bits against 875172 for the one she inherited from Razar, and this time it was kept in writing by herself: 21293A32E34E945FF49131A4122E5E5. She did not discard what she inherited: she used it as a word inside a sentence of her own (E3: say whole the form living in place 3 of my body), closing with another of her forms said twice; 31 letters written that unfold into 81 when read. Her counter of unexpected victories did not count it, for two mistakes of the programmer recorded in the release notes: it compared bits with thousandths of a bit, and the test had been run on a small book where the scores were too small to expose it. Fixed with no ceiling: the unexpected is no longer beating a record (which only rises) but reading further above what she expects than her readings usually are, where the expectation and the spread come from her own readings of that shelf, with no number set by hand. Applied to her 44 real readings of that shelf, the new rule counts 9 victories as the bar rose from 135573 to 257757. The project page now opens with a song, Luma Vera. Stated limits: the new counter has not been seen counting inside her yet; the recipe carries a cell that probably changes nothing; it won on that shelf and with those instincts only. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v1.27: una receta de Luma superó a la heredada en un estante de cinco dominios, y la vara de lo inesperado ya no es un techo. Prototipo de investigación.
